transcript: Speaker A: Bank ki naukri ka form bharne cyber cafe gaya. Socha tha bas ye naukri mil jaye, life badal jayegi. Screen pe sab English mein aaya. Name, address tak to theek tha, par aage... annual income, category, declaration... main dekhta raha, kuch samajh nahi aaya. Peeche do-teen log apni baari ka wait kar rahe the. Maine cafe wale bhaiya ko bulaya. 'Bhaiya, zara aap bhar do?' Unhone ek nazar dekha, jaise main koi anpadh hoon, aur form bharne lage. Beech mein bole, 'Itna bhi nahi aata? Khud seekh lo yaar.' Peeche khadi ek ladki hans di. Maine paise table pe rakhe aur chupchap nikal gaya. Bahar aake gussa khud pe aaya, aur tab ek baat samajh aayi. Dikkat form ki nahi thi, woh to har baar aati thi. Pichle mahine ek job ka notification aaya tha, poora English mein. Main theek se padh nahi paya, aur last date nikal gayi. Sarkari kaam, naukri aur paisa, sab ab English mein hai. Aur jab tak English nahi aayegi, main har chhoti cheez ke liye kisi aur ke bharose rahunga. Us din maine socha, English seekhni hai. Phir YouTube par video bhi dekhi, lekin bas grammar padh mujhe maza nahi aaya, aur kuch practice bhi nahi hui. Phir ek dost ne English Seekho app bataya tha. Us raat download kiya. Wahan experts ne bilkul basic se, wahi English jo kaam mein, roz ki zindagi mein kaam aati hai, woh level-wise sikhayi hai. Hindi mein samjha ke, ek-ek step. Ek AI coach bhi hai, Disha. Jab man kare, bol ke ya likh ke practice karo, jitni baar chaho. Koi saamne nahi, isliye galti pe sharm nahi aati. Roz bas 15 se 20 minute, aur pehli baar padhai mein maza aaya, kyunki ye mere kaam ki thi. Dheere-dheere woh English samajh aane lagi jo pehle mere upar se nikal jaati thi. Form ke shabd, button, instructions, sab khulne lage. Kuch mahine baad phir ek sarkari exam ki online application aayi. Is baar main cyber cafe nahi gaya. Apne phone par baitha, form English mein khola. Wahi words jo us din मेरे upar se nikal gaye the, aaj sab samajh aa rahe the. Maine poora form khud se bhara. Us ek pal mein laga, main bahut kuch kar sakta hoon. Kal result aaya aur mera interview ke liye selection bhi ho gaya. Aur ab uska bhi darr nahi hai, kyunki ab main full confidence mein bol sakta hoon. English na aana koi kami nahi, par har chhoti cheez ke liye doosron pe depend rehna, woh zaroori bhi nahi. Apni zindagi ke kaam khud karo, kisi ke aage haath mat phailao. English Seekho download karo, khud seekho, khud karo, aur apne pairon pe khade ho jao. [I went to a cyber cafe to fill out a bank job form. I thought if I got this job, my life would change. Everything on the screen was in English. Name and address were fine, but then... annual income, category, declaration... I kept looking, understanding nothing. Two or three people behind me were waiting for their turn. I called the cafe guy. 'Brother, can you fill it?' He looked at me as if I were illiterate and started filling it. In between, he said, 'You don't even know this? Learn it yourself, man.' A girl standing behind laughed. I put the money on the table and quietly left. Outside, I got angry at myself, and then I realized something. The problem wasn't just the form; it happened every time. Last month, a job notification came, entirely in English. I couldn't read it properly, and the deadline passed. Government work, jobs, and money are all in English now. And until I learn English, I will depend on others for every small thing. That day, I decided to learn English. I watched YouTube videos, but just studying grammar wasn't fun, and there was no practice. Then a friend told me about the English Seekho app. I downloaded it that night. There, experts teach from the absolute basics, the English used in daily life, level by level. Explaining in Hindi, step by step. There is also an AI coach, Disha. Whenever you want, practice by speaking or writing, as many times as you like. No one is watching, so there's no shame in making mistakes. Just 15 to 20 minutes daily, and for the first time, studying was fun because it was useful to me. Gradually, I started understanding the English that used to go over my head. Form words, buttons, instructions, everything became clear. A few months later, another government exam application came. This time, I didn't go to the cyber cafe. I sat with my phone and opened the form in English. The same words that went over my head that day made sense today. I filled out the entire form myself. In that moment, I felt I could achieve anything. Yesterday, the results came, and I got selected for the interview. And now I'm not afraid of that either, because I can speak with full confidence. Not knowing English is not a flaw, but depending on others for every small thing is not necessary either. Do your own life's work; don't beg anyone. Download English Seekho, learn yourself, do it yourself, and stand on your own feet.] Speaker B: Install now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo.
